<svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
          <defs>
            <linearGradient id="grad1" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
              <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#38bdf8;stop-opacity:1" />
              <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#7c3aed;stop-opacity:1" />
              <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#ec4899;stop-opacity:1" />
            </linearGradient>
            <linearGradient id="grad2" x1="0%" y1="100%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
              <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#06b6d4;stop-opacity:1" />
              <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#8b5cf6;stop-opacity:1" />
            </linearGradient>
          </defs>
          
          <!-- Background circle -->
          <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="95" fill="url(#grad1)" opacity="0.1"/>
          
          <!-- Main outer circle -->
          <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="85" fill="none" stroke="url(#grad1)" stroke-width="2"/>
          
          <!-- Center circle -->
          <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="60" fill="url(#grad2)" opacity="0.95"/>
          
          <!-- Tool icon - combination of different tools -->
          <!-- Wrench (top left) -->
          <g transform="translate(75, 70)">
            <path d="M8 2C4.5 2 2 4.5 2 8c0 2.5 1.5 4.5 3.5 5.5L10 18c0.5 0.5 1.5 0.5 2 0l4.5-4.5c2 -1 3.5 -3 3.5 -5.5 0 -3.5 -2.5 -6 -6 -6z" fill="white" stroke="white" stroke-width="0.5"/>
          </g>
          
          <!-- Calculator (top right) -->
          <g transform="translate(118, 70)">
            <rect x="0" y="0" width="12" height="12" rx="1.5" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="0.8"/>
            <line x1="0" y1="4" x2="12" y2="4" stroke="white" stroke-width="0.6"/>
            <line x1="4" y1="0" x2="4" y2="12" stroke="white" stroke-width="0.6"/>
            <line x1="8" y1="0" x2="8" y2="12" stroke="white" stroke-width="0.6"/>
          </g>
          
          <!-- Notepad (bottom left) -->
          <g transform="translate(70, 118)">
            <rect x="1" y="1" width="11" height="14" rx="1" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="0.8"/>
            <line x1="1" y1="4" x2="12" y2="4" stroke="white" stroke-width="0.6"/>
            <line x1="1" y1="7" x2="12" y2="7" stroke="white" stroke-width="0.6"/>
            <line x1="1" y1="10" x2="12" y2="10" stroke="white" stroke-width="0.6"/>
          </g>
          
          <!-- File/Document (bottom right) -->
          <g transform="translate(120, 118)">
            <path d="M2 1h7l3 3v10a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H3a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V1z" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="0.8"/>
            <line x1="9" y1="1" x2="9" y2="4" stroke="white" stroke-width="0.6"/>
          </g>
          
          <!-- Center star/sparkle - represents the "all-in-one" aspect -->
          <g transform="translate(100, 100)">
            <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="4" fill="white" opacity="0.9"/>
            <path d="M0,-8 L1.5,-2 L8,-1 L3,3 L5,9 L0,5 L-5,9 L-3,3 L-8,-1 L-1.5,-2 Z" fill="white" opacity="0.7"/>
          </g>
          
          <!-- Inner decorative rings -->
          <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="50" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.3"/>
          <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="35" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.2"/>
          
          <!-- Top accent line -->
          <line x1="85" y1="25" x2="115" y2="25" stroke="url(#grad1)" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
        </svg>

<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <rect x="8" y="8" width="8" height="8" rx="1"/>
            <!-- Top arrow -->
            <path d="M12 2v3M10 3l2-1 2 1"/>
            <!-- Bottom arrow -->
            <path d="M12 22v-3M10 21l2 1 2-1"/>
            <!-- Left arrow -->
            <path d="M2 12h3M3 10l-1 2 1 2"/>
            <!-- Right arrow -->
            <path d="M22 12h-3M21 10l1 2-1 2"/>
          </svg>

<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <!-- Page 1 - solid -->
            <rect x="2" y="4" width="4" height="6" rx="0.5"/>
            <!-- Page 2 - solid -->
            <rect x="7" y="4" width="4" height="6" rx="0.5"/>
            <!-- Page 3 - DOTTED (removed) -->
            <rect x="12" y="4" width="4" height="6" rx="0.5" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="1.5 1.5"/>
            <!-- Page 4 - solid -->
            <rect x="17" y="4" width="4" height="6" rx="0.5"/>
            <!-- X mark on dotted page -->
            <path d="M13 5.5l2 2m0-2l-2 2" stroke="white" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
            <!-- Bottom pages row -->
            <rect x="2" y="13" width="4" height="6" rx="0.5"/>
            <rect x="7" y="13" width="4" height="6" rx="0.5"/>
            <rect x="12" y="13" width="4" height="6" rx="0.5"/>
            <rect x="17" y="13" width="4" height="6" rx="0.5"/>
          </svg>

<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path d="M7 2h7l5 5v13a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2Zm6 1.5V8h4.5L13 3.5Z"/>
            <path d="M9 11h6v1.5H9V11Zm0 3h6v1.5H9V14Z"/>
            <!-- Small 'n' on bottom right -->
            <text x="15" y="20" font-size="4" font-weight="bold" fill="white">n</text>
          </svg>

<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <!-- Phone outline -->
            <rect x="7" y="2" width="10" height="20" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="1.8"/>
            <circle cx="12" cy="19" r="0.8"/>
            <path d="M10 5h4"/>
            <!-- Image icon inside phone -->
            <rect x="9" y="8" width="6" height="6" rx="0.5"/>
            <circle cx="10.8" cy="10" r="0.6"/>
            <path d="M15 13l-1.5-1.5-1.5 1.5-1-1-2 2"/>
          </svg>

<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <!-- ID card border -->
            <rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/>
            <!-- Portrait circle -->
            <circle cx="9" cy="10" r="3" fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.3)"/>
            <!-- Shoulders -->
            <path d="M5.5 16a4 4 0 0 1 7 0" fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.3)"/>
            <!-- Text lines on right -->
            <path d="M14 8h5M14 11h4M14 14h5" stroke="rgba(0,0,0,0.3)" stroke-width="1.2"/>
          </svg>
